name: Fathom Core
summary: Beneath the Moonshrine Ruins, the Fathom Core records the elements at work in Blackfathom Deeps. The Earthen Ring seeks it to learn how the Twilight's Hammer turns those forces to its own ends.

sections.title: Elemental Chronicle
sections.body: Inside an ancient fathom stone beneath the Moonshrine Ruins, the Fathom Core records the elements. Its account follows their shifts, disruptions, and surges over time. Je'neu Sancrea is an Earthen Ring shaman at Zoram'gar Outpost. He seeks the core to learn how the Twilight's Hammer cultists turn the region's elements to their own ends.

faq.answer: The Fathom Core records the history of nearby elemental activity. It rests inside an ancient fathom stone in the Moonshrine Ruins.

faq.q: Where is the Fathom Core located?
faq.answer: The Fathom Core lies deep in Blackfathom Deeps beneath the Ashenvale coast. It rests inside a fathom stone under the waters of the Moonshrine Ruins.

faq.q: Who wants the Fathom Core and why?
aliases: why does je'neu want fathom core
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring shaman at Zoram'gar Outpost, seeks the Fathom Core. He and his circle hope its record of elemental shifts will help them understand and counter the Twilight's Hammer's work in the ruins.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer interested in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer cultists have taken up residence in the submerged ruins to coerce and corrupt the local elements. They seek to bend those forces to dark purposes and claim control of the subterranean temple.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see why the Earthen Ring values the Fathom Core. Its record can reveal how others manipulate the elements.
Recovering the Fathom Core aids Je'neu Sancrea and helps secure the Horde's foothold at Zoram'gar Outpost against the Twilight's Hammer's corruptive designs.
